entry.name: linedrive
entry.description: Scales number from one range to another with an exponential curve. Both the input and output ranges are expressed as single arguments representing the maximum value. The minimum values are the negative values of the ranges (argument * -1).

arguments.name: input
arguments.description: The first argument is the maximum input value. The range used is from (argument * -1) to (argument).

arguments.name: output
arguments.description: The second argument is the maximum output value. The range used is from (argument * -1) to (argument).

arguments.name: curve
arguments.description: The third argument specifies the nature of the scaling curve. The third argument must be greater than 1. The larger the value, the more steeply exponential the curve is. An appropriate value for this argument is 1.06.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.description: The fourth argument specifies a ramp time (slew rate). Theobject outputs a list consisting of the scaled output value followed by a ramp time in milliseconds which can be sent to aorobject. The initial argument value can be modifed using theobject's right inlet.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left inlet: The number is converted according to the following expressiony = b e^{-a log c} e^{x log c}where x is the input, y is the output, a, b, and c are the three typed-in arguments, and e is the base of the natural logarithm (approximately 2.718282). The output is a two-item list containing y followed by the delay time most recently received in the right inlet.

messages.name: in1
messages.description: In right inlet: Sets the current delay time appended to the scaled output. A connectedobject will ramp to the new target value over this time interval.
